summary_1line: Rama and Lakshmana arrive with Vishwamitra at Janaka’s sacrifice, where the king honors the sage and asks about the two extraordinary princes.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Janaka, surrounded by priests and ministers, bows before Sage Vishwamitra while Rama and Lakshmana stand beside him at the grand sacrificial pavilion.
Thousands of Vedic brahmins with bullock carts gather around a vast sacrificial pavilion as Rama and Lakshmana gaze upon the preparations.
Janaka, seated among his counselors, gestures toward the radiant princes and asks Vishwamitra about their divine-looking identities.
